name: Scaled loot callbacks safely ignore mapless loading and transfer states
contract: Item scaling only changes creature and chest loot while the owner has a map.
Mail loot can run during achievement rewards in Player::LoadFromDB before SetMap.
Run the registered post-loot hooks with a native Player whose FindMap is null.
Mail and gameobject callbacks must return without asserting or adding items.
This callback fixture does not claim to reproduce a particular live character login.
